import pandas as pd

# 读取表格数据
data = [
    {"班级": "x年级x班1", "总积分": 29, "排名": 1},
    {"班级": "x年级x班2", "总积分": 22, "排名": 2},
    {"班级": "x年级x班3", "总积分": 21, "排名": 3},
    {"班级": "x年级x班4", "总积分": 19, "排名": 4},
    {"班级": "x年级x班5", "总积分": 18, "排名": 6},
    {"班级": "x年级x班6", "总积分": 16, "排名": 8},
    {"班级": "x年级x班7", "总积分": 18, "排名": 6},
    {"班级": "x年级x班8", "总积分": 19, "排名": 4},
]

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# 按总积分排序
df_sorted = df.sort_values("总积分", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
print("=== 按总积分排序 ===")
print(df_sorted[["班级", "总积分", "排名"]])
print()

# 找出最高和最低
highest = df_sorted.iloc[0]
lowest = df_sorted.iloc[-1]
print(f"最高分班级: {highest['班级']}, 总积分: {highest['总积分']}")
print(f"最低分班级: {lowest['班级']}, 总积分: {lowest['总积分']}")
print()

# 分析分布特征
total_points = df_sorted["总积分"]
print("=== 分布特征分析 ===")
print(f"总积分范围: {total_points.min()} - {total_points.max()}")
print(f"平均分: {total_points.mean():.1f}")
print(f"中位数: {total_points.median():.1f}")
print(f"标准差: {total_points.std():.2f}")
print(f"变异系数: {(total_points.std() / total_points.mean()) * 100:.2f}%")
print()

# 计算相邻班级的差距
print("=== 相邻班级积分差距 ===")
for i in range(len(df_sorted)-1):
    diff = df_sorted.iloc[i]['总积分'] - df_sorted.iloc[i+1]['总积分']
    print(f"{df_sorted.iloc[i]['班级']} → {df_sorted.iloc[i+1]['班级']}: 差距 {diff}分")
print()

# 判断分布是否均匀
max_gap = max(total_points) - min(total_points)
avg_gap = max_gap / (len(total_points) - 1)
print(f"最大差距: {max_gap}分")
print(f"平均级差: {avg_gap:.2f}分")
print()

# 三级分层分析
range_points = max_gap
tier_size = range_points / 3
print(f"=== 三级分层分析 ===")
print(f"总分范围: {total_points.min()} - {total_points.max()} (跨度 {range_points}分)")
print(f"建议分层区间大小: 约 {tier_size:.2f}分")
print()

# 定义分层界限
high_cutoff = total_points.max() - tier_size
mid_cutoff = total_points.min() + tier_size

print(f"分层建议:")
print(f"高分层: > {high_cutoff:.1f}分")
print(f"中分层: {mid_cutoff:.1f} - {high_cutoff:.1f}分")
print(f"低分层: < {mid_cutoff:.1f}分")
print()

# 统计各层级班级数
high_tier = df_sorted[df_sorted["总积分"] > high_cutoff]
mid_tier = df_sorted[(df_sorted["总积分"] >= mid_cutoff) & (df_sorted["总积分"] <= high_cutoff)]
low_tier = df_sorted[df_sorted["总积分"] < mid_cutoff]

print("=== 各层级班级统计 ===")
print(f"高分层 (>{high_cutoff:.1f}分): {len(high_tier)}个班级")
print(high_tier[["班级", "总积分"]].to_string(index=False))
print()

print(f"中分层 ({mid_cutoff:.1f}-{high_cutoff:.1f}分): {len(mid_tier)}个班级")
print(mid_tier[["班级", "总积分"]].to_string(index=False))
print()

print(f"低分层 (<{mid_cutoff:.1f}分): {len(low_tier)}个班级")
print(low_tier[["班级", "总积分"]].to_string(index=False))
"}

import pandas as pd

# 读取表格数据
data = [
    {"班级": "x年级x班1", "总积分": 29, "排名": 1},
    {"班级": "x年级x班2", "总积分": 22, "排名": 2},

]

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# 按总积分排序
df_sorted = df.sort_values("总积分", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
print("=== 按总积分排序 ===")
print(df_sorted[["班级", "总积分", "排名"]])
print()

# 找出最高和最低
highest = df_sorted.iloc[0]
lowest = df_sorted.iloc[-1]
print(f"最高分班级: {highest['班级']}, 总积分: {highest['总积分']}")
print(f"最低分班级: {lowest['班级']}, 总积分: {lowest['总积分']}")
print()

# 分析分布特征
total_points = df_sorted["总积分"]
print("=== 分布特征分析 ===")
print(f"总积分范围: {total_points.min()} - {total_points.max()}")
print(f"平均分: {total_points.mean():.1f}")
print(f"中位数: {total_points.median():.1f}")
print(f"标准差: {total_points.std():.2f}")
print(f"变异系数: {(total_points.std() / total_points.mean()) * 100:.2f}%")
print()

# 计算相邻班级的差距
print("=== 相邻班级积分差距 ===")
for i in range(len(df_sorted)-1):
    diff = df_sorted.iloc[i]['总积分'] - df_sorted.iloc[i+1]['总积分']
    print(f"{df_sorted.iloc[i]['班级']} → {df_sorted.iloc[i+1]['班级']}: 差距 {diff}分")
print()

# 判断分布是否均匀
max_gap = max(total_points) - min(total_points)
avg_gap = max_gap / (len(total_points) - 1)
print(f"最大差距: {max_gap}分")
print(f"平均级差: {avg_gap:.2f}分")
print()

# 三级分层分析
range_points = max_gap
tier_size = range_points / 3
print(f"=== 三级分层分析 ===")
print(f"总分范围: {total_points.min()} - {total_points.max()} (跨度 {range_points}分)")
print(f"建议分层区间大小: 约 {tier_size:.2f}分")
print()

# 定义分层界限
high_cutoff = total_points.max() - tier_size
mid_cutoff = total_points.min() + tier_size

print(f"分层建议:")
print(f"高分层: > {high_cutoff:.1f}分")
print(f"中分层: {mid_cutoff:.1f} - {high_cutoff:.1f}分")
print(f"低分层: < {mid_cutoff:.1f}分")
print()

# 统计各层级班级数
high_tier = df_sorted[df_sorted["总积分"] > high_cutoff]
mid_tier = df_sorted[(df_sorted["总积分"] >= mid_cutoff) & (df_sorted["总积分"] <= high_cutoff)]
low_tier = df_sorted[df_sorted["总积分"] < mid_cutoff]

print("=== 各层级班级统计 ===")
print(f"高分层 (>{high_cutoff:.1f}分): {len(high_tier)}个班级")
print(high_tier[["班级", "总积分"]].to_string(index=False))
print()

print(f"中分层 ({mid_cutoff:.1f}-{high_cutoff:.1f}分): {len(mid_tier)}个班级")
print(mid_tier[["班级", "总积分"]].to_string(index=False))
print()

print(f"低分层 (<{mid_cutoff:.1f}分): {len(low_tier)}个班级")
print(low_tier[["班级", "总积分"]].to_string(index=False))
